metadata.name: Test Suite Audit
metadata.description: Feature-first audit of an existing project test suite against real production behavior. The flow resolves a traversal-safe workspace and authority boundary, inventories the complete in-scope source and test corpus, builds and independently reviews a production-grounded taxonomy, maps every test in deterministic independently reviewed batches, and produces reviewed coverage, redundancy, gap, weak-assertion and exact-change recommendations. Users can correct resolved scope or taxonomy without losing unaffected evidence, request analysis only, authorize only the exact reviewed mutation set, revise recommendations, or abort. If changes are authorized, it records a pre-change baseline and recovery contract, applies one logical mutation class at a time with immediate targeted checks, independently reviews the actual delta, runs all applicable broader project gates, and either repairs within authority or performs and verifies a scoped revert. Irreducible evidence or an unsafe baseline can produce only an explicitly selected limited non-mutating report. Local Markdown and self-contained HTML reports are independently reviewed before optional authorized static publication and optional Telegram notification; local mode has no external side effects, and upload or notification failure remains visible. The flow preserves unrelated dirty work, never treats sampling as authorization, never reports failing changed tests as success, and never broadens access or discovers credentials. Choose Test Suite Audit to assess and optionally refactor an existing suite; use Test Planning to design strategy before implementation, Test Generation to add tests for a defined target, Data Analysis for supplied datasets, or Software Development Flow for complete product delivery.

nodes.directive: Resolve the authorized project and audit boundary once for the engine-bound workspace {{workspace_path}}. Reuse the originating request and parent context; ask only for a material fact that cannot be discovered. Read applicable host and project instructions. Identify project root, languages/frameworks, test and source roots, generated/vendor exclusions, dirty-work boundary, permitted read/write/test operations, and any already authorized delivery choice. Preserve unrelated work and never discover credentials or broaden access. Do not choose or return a workspace path: the registry binds it to this execution ID. Return an empty object after the scope facts are resolved; detailed scope is written after materialization.
nodes.completionCondition: The actual project, authority, instructions, exclusions, dirty-work boundary, and engine-bound workspace are resolved without repository mutation

nodes.directive: Use the immutable registry-backed standard at {{workspace_path}}/audit-standard.md; never rewrite it. Write {{workspace_path}}/scope.md with the resolved authority, project root, instructions, inclusions/exclusions, dirty-work boundary, commands and constraints. Inspect the complete in-scope production and test corpus; write {{workspace_path}}/inventory.md with actual languages, frameworks, runners, source/test roots, generated/vendor exclusions, test files/cases, commands, and observable gaps. Write {{workspace_path}}/taxonomy.md grounded in reproducible production references, including cross-cutting aspects, infrastructure, orphan candidates, multi-behaviour tests, incidental coverage and parameterized paths. Write {{workspace_path}}/batch-plan.md with a proportionate deterministic partition covering every inventory test exactly once. Initialize {{workspace_path}}/mappings.md without claiming uninspected mappings. Return batch_total equal to the actual batch count and batch_cursor 0. Do not mutate the repository under audit.
nodes.completionCondition: Canonical scope, complete inventory, production-grounded taxonomy and complete deterministic batch plan are on disk under the immutable standard; cursor and total exactly match the plan

nodes.directive: Review {{workspace_path}}/scope.md, {{workspace_path}}/inventory.md, {{workspace_path}}/taxonomy.md, {{workspace_path}}/batch-plan.md and {{workspace_path}}/audit-standard.md independently in a genuinely separate host-supported context. Read primary production and test sources directly. Verify complete scope and inventory, production-grounded feature taxonomy, explicit infrastructure/orphan/multi-behaviour/incidental/aspect/parameterized treatment, pairwise-disjoint complete batches, and exact batch_total. Overwrite {{workspace_path}}/taxonomy-review.md with every reproducible blocking finding and its earliest stale producer. Diagnose only; do not repair. Return only exact bounded issues_count; zero is valid.
nodes.completionCondition: A complete independent current taxonomy/inventory/batch review is on disk and issues_count equals all blocking findings

nodes.directive: Read the complete {{workspace_path}}/taxonomy-review.md and reproduce every finding against primary sources. Repair each confirmed defect at its earliest source in {{workspace_path}}/scope.md, inventory.md, taxonomy.md or batch-plan.md; reject false findings in the review report. Regenerate every actually affected downstream artifact and reset mappings.md and batch_cursor when prior mapping evidence is stale. Preserve only genuinely unaffected evidence. Return repair_reach scope when scope/inventory changed, taxonomy when the current evidence was repaired, or irreducible when a reproduced taxonomy defect cannot be resolved under current access or authority; for irreducible record exact incomplete scope and prohibited conclusions in {{workspace_path}}/analysis.md. Return exact current batch_total and batch_cursor 0. Do not mutate the audited repository.
nodes.completionCondition: All confirmed findings are repaired at their earliest producers and every affected derived artifact is regenerated

nodes.directive: Present the resolved scope, exclusions, inventory basis and zero-reviewed taxonomy to the user. Reuse an explicit correction already supplied. Otherwise ask whether these artifacts are accepted or require correction. Return accept only for explicit acceptance. For correct, require non-blank feedback and correction_target scope or taxonomy. Do not change files or infer acceptance from silence.
nodes.completionCondition: The user explicitly accepted the resolved scope/taxonomy or supplied a bounded correction and target

nodes.directive: Apply this explicit user correction to its already validated canonical target: {{confirm-scope-taxonomy.correction_target}}; feedback: {{confirm-scope-taxonomy.feedback}}. For scope, change scope.md and let the route enter discover-corpus so inventory, taxonomy, batches and mappings are regenerated. For taxonomy, update {{workspace_path}}/taxonomy.md, regenerate affected batch/mapping evidence, clear {{workspace_path}}/mappings.md, and reset the cursor. Do not restate or override the target, and do not mutate the audited repository. Return only batch_cursor 0; preserve only genuinely unaffected evidence.
nodes.completionCondition: The explicit correction is applied to the user-selected owner and all affected derived evidence is invalidated

nodes.directive: Map exactly batch {{batch_cursor}} of {{batch_total}} from {{workspace_path}}/batch-plan.md. Read every assigned test and its real assertions plus referenced production behavior. Append or replace that batch's canonical entry in {{workspace_path}}/mappings.md with one record per test/case, feature/aspect links, boundary value, infrastructure/orphan/multi-behaviour/incidental/parameterized status, production references, limitations and unresolved taxonomy gaps. Do not map another batch, mutate the audited repository, or infer coverage from names.
nodes.completionCondition: The current batch has one complete source-grounded canonical mapping and other batch evidence is unchanged

nodes.directive: Independently review the complete current mapping for batch {{batch_cursor}} in {{workspace_path}}/mappings.md in a genuinely separate context. Read {{workspace_path}}/batch-plan.md, taxonomy.md, inventory.md and every assigned primary test/production source. Verify completeness, assertion-level behavior, feature/aspect links, boundaries, special categories and taxonomy gaps. Overwrite {{workspace_path}}/mapping-review.md with all current reproducible findings and earliest owner. Diagnose only. Return exact bounded issues_count; zero is valid.
nodes.completionCondition: The complete current batch mapping has an independent review and exact issue count

nodes.directive: Read {{workspace_path}}/mapping-review.md and reproduce every finding. Repair confirmed defects at the earliest actual owner in the canonical workspace artifacts. Return repair_reach mapping for a current-batch-only mapping correction, taxonomy if taxonomy changes, scope if scope/inventory changes, or irreducible when current access/authority cannot resolve reproduced evidence. Mapping preserves accepted unaffected batches. Taxonomy or scope reach resets batch_cursor to 0, regenerates every affected artifact and review source, and cannot preserve stale mappings. For irreducible, write exact incomplete scope and prohibited conclusions to {{workspace_path}}/analysis.md without inventing evidence. Do not mutate the audited repository.
nodes.completionCondition: Every finding is repaired with correct invalidation reach or a reproduced irreducible evidence boundary is recorded

nodes.directive: Explain the reproduced taxonomy/mapping evidence that cannot be resolved under current access or authority. Ask for exactly limited_report or abort. limited_report authorizes only a truthful non-mutating report naming exact incomplete scope and excluding unsupported coverage, redundancy and change conclusions. Abort authorizes no later mutation. Do not infer a choice from silence.
nodes.completionCondition: The user explicitly selected limited non-mutating reporting or abort

nodes.directive: Read the complete zero-reviewed {{workspace_path}}/scope.md, inventory.md, taxonomy.md and every batch in mappings.md. Write {{workspace_path}}/analysis.md with evidence-backed coverage, redundancy, gaps, weak assertions, misplaced tests, infrastructure findings, costs, limitations, and an exact ordered recommendation set. Distinguish production behavior from test implementation and sampled diagnostics from complete evidence. Every proposed deletion, merge, rewrite, move or creation must name observable value, risk, affected files, logical mutation class, targeted check, broader gates and recovery needs. Do not mutate the repository or claim unsupported conclusions.
nodes.completionCondition: A complete source-grounded analysis and exact change recommendation set are on disk without repository mutation

nodes.directive: Independently review {{workspace_path}}/analysis.md against {{workspace_path}}/audit-standard.md, scope.md, inventory.md, taxonomy.md, mappings.md and primary code/tests. Verify every coverage/redundancy/gap claim, exact recommendation, deletion value retention, mutation class, test evidence, authority and limitation. Overwrite {{workspace_path}}/analysis-review.md with all reproducible blockers and earliest stale owner. Diagnose only. Return exact bounded issues_count; zero is valid.
nodes.completionCondition: The complete current analysis has an independent primary-source review and exact issue count

nodes.directive: Read {{workspace_path}}/analysis-review.md and reproduce every finding. Repair confirmed defects at their earliest canonical workspace owner. Return repair_reach analysis when only analysis.md changes, taxonomy when taxonomy or mappings change, or scope when scope/inventory changes. For taxonomy/scope, reset mappings and batch cursor and regenerate every affected derived artifact; do not preserve stale review acceptance. Do not mutate the audited repository.
nodes.completionCondition: Every confirmed analysis-review defect is repaired at the earliest source with complete invalidation

nodes.directive: Present the complete zero-reviewed analysis and exact recommendation set. Ask for exactly analysis_only, apply, revise or abort unless the originating request already explicitly selected the exact current option. apply authorizes only the current reviewed set; revise requires non-blank feedback and changes recommendations before renewed review; analysis_only forbids repository mutation; abort forbids every later file, repository and external mutation. Never infer approval.
nodes.completionCondition: The user explicitly selected one closed outcome for the current reviewed recommendation set

nodes.directive: Apply this non-blank recommendation feedback at its earliest source: {{present-recommendations.feedback}}. Return repair_reach analysis, taxonomy or scope. Scope/taxonomy reach regenerates all affected inventory, batches, mappings and reviews and resets batch_cursor; analysis reach changes {{workspace_path}}/analysis.md and returns through independent analysis review. Do not mutate the repository.
nodes.completionCondition: The requested revision is applied with truthful invalidation reach and no repository mutation

nodes.directive: Before mutation, inspect project-native version control and project policy. Write baseline.md with branch/bookmark, exact dirty state and unrelated changes to preserve, existing relevant test results, approved files and change classes, recovery method, and whether later evidence can distinguish audit-caused effects. Return baseline_state ready only when safe scoped mutation and restoration are observable; otherwise limited. For ready, return change_class_total equal to the ordered logical classes in the exact reviewed recommendation set and change_class_cursor 0. Do not mutate the repository.
nodes.completionCondition: A factual pre-change baseline and scoped recovery contract exist, or mutation is truthfully closed as limited

nodes.directive: Explain why baseline.md cannot support safe mutation. Ask for exactly limited_report or abort. limited_report permits only a truthful non-mutating report; abort performs no later mutation. Do not infer a choice.
nodes.completionCondition: The user explicitly selected limited reporting or abort after the unusable baseline

nodes.directive: Apply exactly logical mutation class {{change_class_cursor}} of {{change_class_total}} from the currently authorized zero-reviewed {{workspace_path}}/analysis.md recommendation set. Stay inside authorized files and behavior, preserve unrelated work, retain observable value for deletion/merge, and append a one-to-one account to {{workspace_path}}/changes.md. Do not begin the next class or run broad gates yet.
nodes.completionCondition: Exactly the current authorized logical class is applied and accounted for without unrelated mutation

nodes.directive: Run the project-discovered relevant targeted checks for only logical mutation class {{change_class_cursor}} before any next class starts. Compare with {{workspace_path}}/baseline.md, append exact commands/results and failure attribution to {{workspace_path}}/verification.md, and return pass only when this class introduces no unresolved failure. Do not weaken tests or hide failures.
nodes.completionCondition: The current class has immediate reproducible targeted evidence that distinguishes it from a post-hoc mixed run

nodes.directive: Present the exact targeted failure for logical mutation class {{change_class_cursor}}. Ask for exactly repair or revert. repair may change only the current authorized class and must rerun this same targeted check before cursor advancement. revert restores all audit-owned changes and enters restoration verification. Silence performs neither action.
nodes.completionCondition: The user explicitly selected repair of the current class or scoped revert

nodes.directive: Repair the reproduced targeted failure only within authorized logical mutation class {{change_class_cursor}}. Preserve unrelated work and update {{workspace_path}}/changes.md. Do not advance the cursor; the same targeted check must pass next.
nodes.completionCondition: The current class is repaired within exact authority and ready for its same targeted check

nodes.directive: Independently review the actual complete audit-owned repository delta against the exact currently authorized recommendation set, {{workspace_path}}/baseline.md, changes.md, primary code/tests and project instructions. Verify one-to-one scope, preserved unrelated work, retained behavior, documentation/coverage obligations and current targeted evidence. Overwrite {{workspace_path}}/change-review.md with every reproducible blocker and whether its earliest repair is contained inside the approved set or scope-changing. Diagnose only. Return exact bounded issues_count; zero is valid.
nodes.completionCondition: The complete actual changed work has an independent authorization and correctness review with exact issue count

nodes.directive: Read {{workspace_path}}/change-review.md, reproduce all findings and repair confirmed defects. Return repair_reach contained only when all changes stay inside the exact authorized set and relevant targeted checks pass. Return scope_changing if recommendations/authority must change; first restore any unauthorized delta and verify that restoration, then update {{workspace_path}}/analysis.md with the necessary recommendation change. Preserve unrelated work and update changes.md/verification.md factually.
nodes.completionCondition: Confirmed changed-work defects are repaired within authority or unauthorized delta is restored before reauthorization

nodes.directive: Preserve all per-class targeted evidence in {{workspace_path}}/verification.md, then run every applicable broader affected/package/integration/browser/full project gate in discovered project/risk cost order. Compare with {{workspace_path}}/baseline.md, write exact commands/results and attribution to verification.md, and return pass only when the complete authorized delta is verified with no audit-caused failure. Do not mask pre-existing or infrastructure limitations.
nodes.completionCondition: All applicable broader gates have factual baseline-comparable evidence and one truthful verification state

nodes.directive: Present the exact audit-caused targeted or broad failure and current safe options. Ask for exactly repair or revert. repair stays inside current authority and must return through changed-work review and validation. revert restores only audit-owned changes and requires restoration verification. Silence performs neither action.
nodes.completionCondition: The user explicitly selected contained repair or scoped revert for the observed failure

nodes.directive: Repair the reproduced audit-caused failure only within the exact authorized recommendation set. Preserve unrelated work, update changes.md, run relevant targeted checks for affected logical classes, and record results in verification.md. Do not broaden scope or claim success. Return through independent changed-work review and all applicable broader gates.
nodes.completionCondition: The authorized repair is applied with current targeted evidence and ready for independent review

nodes.directive: Using {{workspace_path}}/baseline.md and changes.md, restore only audit-owned changes to the exact pre-audit state. Preserve unrelated dirty work. Then verify the restoration with project-native diff/status and the smallest relevant checks, recording exact evidence in {{workspace_path}}/verification.md. Return restored only when the audit delta is absent and unrelated state is preserved; otherwise blocked. Do not call an unexecuted revert a success.
nodes.completionCondition: Scoped restoration has been actually attempted and its observable result is recorded

nodes.directive: For the current report-producing outcome {{outcome}}, read every current canonical artifact and actual repository state. Overwrite {{workspace_path}}/final-report.md and {{workspace_path}}/report.html with the same truthful account: scope, complete evidence, reviewed conclusions, proposals versus actual work, baseline and final test state, exact incomplete scope/unsupported conclusions for limited outcomes, verified revert state, privacy/licensing/minimization checks, and limitations. Never use success wording for limited or reverted outcomes. The terminal report_path is the registry-fixed relative path final-report.md inside this execution-bound workspace; do not return or alter it. Do not upload or notify here.
nodes.completionCondition: Both local report artifacts truthfully represent the current canonical outcome at the execution-bound paths

nodes.directive: Independently review {{workspace_path}}/final-report.md and report.html against all canonical workspace sources, actual repository state, originating authority and current outcome. Verify complete factual accounting, no stale evidence, no unsupported success, privacy/licensing/minimization, safe publication content and exact terminal discovery paths. Overwrite {{workspace_path}}/final-review.md with every reproducible blocker and earliest repair reach: report, analysis or work. Diagnose only. Return exact bounded issues_count; zero is valid.
nodes.completionCondition: The complete current final account has an independent review and exact issue count

nodes.directive: Current outcome: {{outcome}}. Read {{workspace_path}}/final-review.md and reproduce every finding. For report reach, repair only final-report.md/report.html and return report. For analysis reach, repair canonical analysis evidence; if any audit-owned repository delta exists, restore and verify it first, then return analysis. If the finding concerns actual applied work, do not mutate it here: return work_applied only when the current outcome is changes_applied. If it concerns restoration, do not mutate it here: return work_reverted only when the current outcome is changes_reverted. Non-mutating outcomes have no valid work reach and must use report/analysis or expose the factual blocker. Reject false findings. The following route validates outcome before any work repair.
nodes.completionCondition: Confirmed report/analysis defects are repaired, or a work/restoration defect is classified without premature mutation for outcome validation

nodes.directive: Reuse an explicit originating delivery choice for this exact reviewed report, otherwise ask once for local, publish or publish_notify. local performs no external side effect. publish uploads only report.html through the authorized Moira static-artifact file/archive API. publish_notify additionally sends Telegram only after a real URL exists. Do not infer external authority.
nodes.completionCondition: One explicit closed delivery choice is resolved for the zero-reviewed local report

nodes.directive: Upload only the zero-reviewed self-contained {{workspace_path}}/report.html using the authorized Moira static-artifact file/archive API. Do not upload raw sources, workspace files or sensitive records. Return uploaded only after observing the real public URL and set report_url to it. On any failure return failed and set report_url to an empty string; never invent a URL and do not notify.
nodes.completionCondition: The real upload result is observed and report_url is truthful

nodes.directive: Send one factual Telegram notification through the configured authorized integration. Include outcome {{outcome}}, report URL {{report_url}}, limitations and exact test result summary; disclose reverted or limited state without success wording. Return sent only after observing delivery confirmation, otherwise failed. Notification failure does not invalidate the reviewed local report or uploaded artifact.
nodes.completionCondition: The authorized notification attempt has an observed truthful state

nodes.directive: Repair the reproduced final-review defect in the actual applied audit-owned work, staying inside the exact authorized recommendation set. Update {{workspace_path}}/changes.md, run affected logical-class targeted checks, and record them in verification.md. Do not broaden scope. Return through independent changed-work review and broader verification.
nodes.completionCondition: The applied-work defect is repaired within exact authority with current targeted evidence

nodes.directive: Repair the reproduced restoration defect by restoring only audit-owned changes from {{workspace_path}}/baseline.md and changes.md. Preserve unrelated work, rerun project-native restoration checks, and update verification.md. Return restored only after the audit delta is absent; otherwise blocked.
nodes.completionCondition: The restoration defect is repaired or remains factually blocked with current evidence

workspace_path.description: Execution-bound canonical workspace; rendered from the current system execution ID

batch_total.description: Exact current count of deterministic mapping batches

batch_cursor.description: Engine-owned zero-based current mapping batch cursor

change_class_total.description: Exact count of authorized logical mutation classes

report_path.description: Canonical relative report path inside the current execution-bound workspace

report_url.description: Observed public report URL, empty when no successful upload occurred

notification_state.description: Observed notification or pre-notification delivery state

audit_standard.default:
# Test Suite Audit standard

## Authority and scope

Audit only the project, roots, data, commands and side effects supplied by the caller or explicitly authorized by applicable project instructions. Tool availability is not authorization. Never discover credentials, broaden paths, overwrite unrelated work, publish, notify, delete tests, or mutate a repository without the exact authority required by the current route. Record inclusions, exclusions, generated and vendor boundaries, dirty work to preserve, and material limitations before drawing conclusions.

## Complete corpus

Discover the actual project languages, frameworks, runners, source roots, test roots, commands and policy. Inventory the complete in-scope production and test corpus before deriving counts. Every in-scope test or parameterized case must appear exactly once in the deterministic batch plan. Empty and small corpora are valid and must not be inflated. Unsupported or inaccessible evidence remains explicit.

## Feature-first taxonomy

Ground features and behaviors in reproducible production references, not filenames or test names. Preserve test levels only as the project defines them. Represent cross-cutting aspects, infrastructure tests, orphan candidates, multi-behavior tests, incidental coverage, parameterized paths, edge cases, negative paths and defense in depth. A taxonomy gap invalidates affected mappings and downstream analysis.

## Assertion-level mapping

Read each assigned test and its real assertions plus referenced production behavior. Map every test or case to feature and aspect evidence, boundary value, purpose, special category and limitations. Sampling may diagnose quality but never authorize whole-suite conclusions, deletion or mutation. A known-defective or unresolved mapping cannot advance to authoritative recommendations. Irreducible evidence can produce only an explicitly selected limited non-mutating report that names exact incomplete scope and excludes unsupported conclusions.

## Analysis and recommendations

Derive coverage, redundancy, gaps, weak assertions, misplaced tests, costs and risks only from the complete zero-reviewed evidence. Separate production behavior from test implementation. Every proposed creation, rewrite, move, merge or deletion must name affected files, retained observable value, logical mutation class, relevant targeted checks, broader project gates and recovery needs. Deletion requires project permission and retained value. An empty recommendation set is a valid no-changes result.

## Independent review and repair

Taxonomy, each mapping batch, complete analysis, actual changed work and final reports require a genuinely independent review against primary sources. Reviewers diagnose and overwrite the stable review file; they do not repair. Only an exact zero issue count advances to the corresponding authoritative next stage. A repair changes the earliest confirmed owner and returns through every invalidated producer and review. Unchanged loops, fixed retry counts and warning-based success are prohibited.

## Mutation, verification and recovery

Repository mutation requires explicit approval of the exact current zero-reviewed recommendation set. Establish a baseline that distinguishes pre-existing state, audit-owned changes and unrelated work, and prove a scoped recovery method before mutation. Apply one project-discovered logical mutation class at a time and run its relevant targeted checks before the next class. After independent changed-work review, run every applicable affected, package, integration, browser and full project gate in project and risk cost order. An audit-caused failure requires an explicit repair or revert choice. Repair stays within authority and re-enters review and validation. Revert restores only audit-owned changes, preserves unrelated work and is successful only after observable restoration verification. A failing changed suite never becomes successful delivery.

## Reporting, privacy and delivery

Create truthful local Markdown and self-contained HTML reports before external delivery. Distinguish reviewed analysis, no changes, applied changes, verified revert, limited analysis and recovery blockage. Separate proposals from actual work and state baseline, final checks, incomplete scope and limitations. Minimize sensitive data, respect confidentiality, consent, retention and licensing, and exclude raw private records or secrets. Publication and Telegram require separate explicit delivery authority. Upload only the reviewed self-contained HTML, record only an observed URL, notify only after successful upload, and expose upload or notification failure without invalidating the local report.
audit_standard.description: Immutable project-neutral Test Suite Audit policy materialized for every independent reader
